headline: Court portals went offline after vendor Journal Technologies saw malicious automated activity Nov 13. Who and what was taken: unknown.
summary: First draft. 9 sources (5 Tier 1, 4 Tier 2), 18 claims (6 Confirmed, 7 Reported, 5 Not established), 7 questions. The attack is Confirmed on the vendor's own statements (Tier 1); the vendor's ARTEX comparison is Reported as its own description. Attribution, data exposure, full restoration, total courts affected and any link to the week's other outages are Not established. Privacy check done: no names of individuals, no spokespeople or reporters, no handles or contact details.
